name: The Bhagavad Gita
translation: Selected excerpts adapted from The Song Celestial, the public-domain verse translation of Sir Edwin Arnold (1885)
note: The song of the Lord — the dialogue between the warrior Arjuna and the charioteer Krishna on the field of Kurukshetra, on the eve of battle. Seven hundred verses that hold the whole of Hindu teaching: duty, devotion, and the Self that cannot be slain.
